records.title: Yoga Sūtras of Patañjali
records.summary: A concise philosophical source for examining attention, practice, discipline, and the movement of mind. Return to individual sūtras with the guidance of your assigned translation.
records.edition: Patañjali, The Yoga-System of Patañjali, translated by James Haughton Woods (Harvard University Press, 1914).
records.question: What changes when I observe before responding?
records.rights: Published in 1914 and available as a public-domain scan through Internet Archive. This historical translation may differ from the edition assigned in a specific course.
records.curriculum: Follow the approved cohort reference sheet; no page or verse assignment is supplied here.
records.provenance: Edition and PDF verified October 20, 2026 through the Internet Archive scan of the University of Toronto copy.

records.title: Bhagavad Gītā
records.summary: A dialogue between Kṛṣṇa and Arjuna studied in relation to action, discernment, devotion, knowledge, responsibility, and liberation. Use the edition named in a course when completing assigned passages.
records.edition: The Song Celestial; or, Bhagavad-Gîtâ, translated by Sir Edwin Arnold (1885), Project Gutenberg eBook 2388.
records.question: How might disciplined action remain responsible without becoming attached to recognition or outcome?
records.status: Open public-domain edition · free eBook and audio
records.linkLabel: Read or download from Project Gutenberg
records.rights: Sir Edwin Arnold’s 1885 translation is public domain in the United States. Project Gutenberg provides free HTML and downloadable eBook formats. This historical poetic rendering may differ from a course-assigned translation.
records.curriculum: Consult the approved cohort reference sheet for the assigned translation, chapter, and verse. This public-domain edition supports general reading alongside the School.
records.provenance: Project Gutenberg title, translator, edition, and public access verified October 20, 2026.
records.imageAlt: Senses Yoga School sun mark used as a neutral study image; not a book cover or manuscript image.
records.imageCaption: Senses Yoga School sun mark; neutral study image, not the edition cover.
records.imageChanges: Displayed as a neutral school mark.

records.title: Haṭha Yoga Pradīpikā
records.summary: A traditional manual placing posture, breath, and other practices within a developing discipline. Study its historical language with context and appropriate teaching guidance.
records.edition: Svātmārāma, Haṭha Yoga Pradīpikā, translated by Pancham Sinh (1914).
records.question: How do preparation and repetition shape practice?
records.status: Open public-domain edition · free text and PDF
records.rights: The Pancham Sinh translation was published in 1914 and is public domain in the United States. Links lead to the Internet Sacred Text Archive and a public rare-book PDF.
records.curriculum: Follow the approved cohort reference sheet; no page or verse assignment is supplied here.
records.provenance: Edition, translator, publication year, online text, and PDF access verified October 20, 2026.

records.imageCaption: Haṭha Yoga Pradīpikā manuscript, Schøyen Collection; nineteenth-century copy.

records.title: Light on Prāṇāyāma
records.summary: B.K.S. Iyengar’s modern study of prāṇāyāma, used by the School for selected breath-study references. It remains copyrighted and should be borrowed or purchased through lawful channels.
records.edition: B.K.S. Iyengar, Light on Prāṇāyāma: Prāṇāyāma Dīpikā. Unwin Paperbacks, 1983 reprint of the 1981 George Allen & Unwin first edition. ISBN 0-04-149060-6.
records.question: How do precision, preparation, and observation shape a responsible breath practice?
records.status: School reference edition verified · copyrighted modern work
records.linkLabel: Find or borrow through Open Library
records.rights: The School holds a reference PDF in its internal Google Drive. The edition’s copyright page states that it is protected under the Berne Convention and may not be reproduced without permission. The public Library therefore provides lawful borrowing and publisher pathways rather than exposing the School’s Drive copy.
records.curriculum: This is the verified School reference edition. When a course assigns a chapter or page, use this edition unless the instructor names another. Practice breath retention and advanced techniques only with appropriate instruction.
records.provenance: The School’s reference copy was reviewed October 20, 2026. Title page, publication history, copyright notice, publisher, year, and ISBN were verified directly from the file.
records.imageAlt: Historical Haṭha Yoga manuscript used as contextual breath-study artwork; not the cover of Light on Prāṇāyāma.
records.imageCaption: Historical Haṭha Yoga manuscript; contextual image, not the book cover.

records.title: The Rāmāyaṇa
records.summary: A sustained narrative inquiry into relationship, duty, devotion, difficult choices, and their consequences. The school returns to the epic through reading, reflection, and practice.
records.edition: Vālmīki, The Rámáyan of Válmíki, translated by Ralph T. H. Griffith (public-domain historical edition).
records.question: What information, pressures, and responsibilities shape a choice?
records.rights: The linked historical English translation is public domain in the United States. It is a supplemental edition and does not replace the separate Goldman or Shastri readings named in internal assignments.
records.curriculum: Semester I Week 12 reference sheet names separate Goldman and Shastri readings. Their pagination must remain separate. Exact assignments are retained in the internal reference sheet.
records.provenance: Public-domain Griffith access verified October 20, 2026 through Internet Archive. The School preserves edition distinctions for assigned passages.

records.question: How can expressive practice deepen attention and relationship?
